motivations.quote: The only bad workout is the one that didn't happen.
motivations.author: Stay focused!

motivations.quote: Push yourself because no one else is going to do it for you.
motivations.author: Keep going!

motivations.quote: Your body can stand almost anything. It’s your mind you have to convince.
motivations.author: Train your mind.

motivations.quote: The pain you feel today will be the strength you feel tomorrow.
motivations.author: Trust the process.

motivations.quote: Don’t stop when you’re tired. Stop when you’re done.
motivations.author: Finish strong.

motivations.quote: You don’t have to be extreme, just consistent.
motivations.author: Consistency wins.
